name.help: Display name for this Exchange Online communication channel.

tenant_id.help: Microsoft Entra tenant ID used for the client-credentials token request.

client_id.help: Microsoft Entra app registration client ID with Microsoft Graph Mail.Send permission.

client_secret.help: Microsoft Entra client secret. Stored encrypted at rest.

from_address.help: Exchange Online mailbox used as the Graph sendMail user.

from_name.help: Optional display name retained for compatibility with other email channels.

subject_prefix.help: Optional prefix added to every notification subject.

title: Exchange Online notification delivery
subtitle: Plugin-owned
description: This plugin owns the Exchange Online. It stores Microsoft Graph settings on the channel itself and does not use the removed host email-server surface.
securityDescription: The client secret is stored encrypted at rest. Use a dedicated Entra app registration with Microsoft Graph Mail.Send application permission.
testDescription: The host test action sends a real email through this Exchange Online channel. Use a test recipient first if your mailbox reaches an on-call list.
secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
setupGuideTitle: Exchange Online communication channel setup guide

step1.body: Create or choose a Microsoft Entra app registration dedicated to McHarbor notification delivery.

step2.body: Add Microsoft Graph application permission Mail.Send and grant admin consent for the tenant.

step3.body: Create a client secret and <warn>store it only in the McHarbor channel configuration</warn>.

step4.body: Set Tenant ID, Client ID, and Client secret from the Entra app registration.

step5.body: Set From address to the Exchange Online mailbox that will send notifications. The app must be allowed to send as that mailbox.

step6.body: Add one or more comma-separated recipients. Start with a test mailbox, then switch to your operations or on-call distribution list once delivery is confirmed.

step7.body: Optionally set Subject prefix, for example [McHarbor Prod], so alerts are easy to filter in mail clients and ticketing systems.

step8.body: Save the channel and click Test connection. The plugin sends a real test email through the same Microsoft Graph path used for live workflow, alert, and backup events.

step9.body: If Test fails with an OAuth or Graph error, verify app permissions, admin consent, tenant ID, mailbox address, and Exchange application access policies.
